title.narrative: Life-Saving Cash Transfers and Flood Risk Communication for El Nino Flood-Affected Communities in Camp Jirix IDP, Kurman IDP and Xabaal cadeey IDP of Bardhere, Somalia

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-family:"gtThe proposed Emergency Response project will provide immediate life-saving assistance to 880 internally displaced persons (IDPs) and poor host community households (200 in Iftin, 200 in Camp Jirix, 200 in Hawala Cadee, and 2lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:"gt80 in Buula Kurman) through unconditional cash transfers. The project will also focus on flood risk communication, enhanced community surveillance, and alert systems.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal"gtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtTen community mobilizers and surveillance teams will be recruited for two months to provide alerts and awareness in the district's hotspot areas. The team will be equipped with a rental vehicle and will monitor the river situation and engage with communities at the household and community levels. HIRDA will use the media to deliver risk communication messages to the community, with three messages released every one months.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal"gtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtThe proposed project contributes to the Food Security Cluster's objectives of improving availability and access to food for 6.7 million people facing severe acute food insecurity by the end of 2023 and preventing the loss of lives of 6.7 million of the most vulnerable.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal"gtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtSpecific activities: -lt/spangtlt/pgtltulgtltligtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtProvision of immediate life-saving emergency food assistance through unconditional cash transfers, allowing severely food insecure flood-affected households to meet their basic food needs.lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtFlood risk communication, enhanced community surveillance, and alert system.lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtClose coordination of activities with existing emergency and recovery interventions and across actors to maximize efficiencies, minimize duplication, and enhance the humanitarian impact of the flood interventions.lt/spangtlt/ligtltligtltspan lang="EN-US"gtHIRDA will coordnaite SHF projects Funded under RA5 including other clusters in Baardheere, Gedo Regionltbrgtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/ligtltp class="" style=""gtltspan lang="EN-US" style=""gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtlt/ulgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
